summary: Wrote /app/bin/summarize.py (handles all eight depot formats, gzip/BOM/charset, mid-file directives and headers, corrections, resends, handovers) and ran it to produce /app/out/summary.json. It uses the lb/oz factors written in summary-format.md (0.45392, 0.02837), but check_summary.py's reference figures only match with the standard factors (0.45359237, 0.028349523): with those every value matches, with the documented ones 6 depot and 4 month values differ. I kept the documented factors, so the doc and the checker disagree and someone should decide which is right; the fix is the FACT table at the top of the script.
